question: How often does the cluster signing key rotate?
title: Signing key rotation
content: The cluster signing key rotates every 90 days, and the break-glass procedure for an early rotation is kept in the security vault.

question: What happens when the platform team overspends the quarterly cloud budget?
title: Cloud budget
content: The quarterly cloud budget of the platform team is capped, and an overspend pages the finance controller before new capacity is approved.

question: How is the stipend for weekend shifts paid?
title: Weekend stipend
content: Engineers covering a weekend shift receive a fixed stipend, paid with the next payroll run after the shift.

question: How long are customer audit logs retained?
title: Data retention
content: Customer audit logs are retained for seven years under the retention schedule agreed with the regulator.

question: Who triggers regional failover to the standby region?
title: Regional failover
content: Regional failover to the standby region is triggered by the incident commander once database replica lag is below one minute.

question: What did the last penetration test find on the staging ingress?
title: Penetration test findings
content: The last penetration test found an exposed admin dashboard behind the staging ingress; remediation is tracked in the security backlog.

question: When does the GPU vendor contract renew?
title: GPU vendor contract
content: The GPU vendor contract reserves capacity at a discount tier and renews every March unless cancelled in writing.

question: When are performance review calibration meetings held?
title: Calibration calendar
content: Performance review calibration meetings are held in the second week of November for every engineering manager.

question: Which approval do encryption modules need for export?
title: Export control
content: Encryption modules shipped abroad need an export control licence, and counsel must approve each licence before shipping.

question: How fast do severity one incidents page the secondary responder?
title: Paging policy
content: Severity one incidents page the primary responder at once and the secondary responder within five minutes through the escalation policy.
